scientific_integrity: Analytical limiting proof from an exact rank-one resolvent and controlled quartic-band-edge scaling; independent external review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed scaled detuning s as impurity strength tends to zero; no joint-uniform limit as |s| tends to infinity.
Repulsive single-site on-site defect and positive next-nearest-neighbor hopping on an infinite chain only.
Equivalent scaling in earlier transfer-matrix literature, whose complete text was inaccessible, has not been excluded.
The finite-dimensional eigenvalue comparisons are computational diagnostics, not proofs of an infinite-lattice limit.
title: A quartic-edge impurity crossover in a zigzag quantum chain
